title: GNSS: reference current edition of ICAO Annex 10 for SBAS L1 definition
description:
Reference current edition of ICAO Annex 10, Vol I (8th edition) for the
definition of SBAS L1 messages. Add SBAS service provider identifiers
as defined by this edition.

notes.body:
This warning looks legitimate to me?

Warning: epan/dissectors/packet-sbas_l1.c hf_sbas_l1_mt17_health_and_status_spid filter= sbas_l1.mt17.health_and_status.spid VALS(SBAS_SPID) has max value 31 (0x1f) which doesn't fit into 4 bits ( mask is 0x3c00 )

Does this field now have more bits - all of the impossible values are reserved so far...
Ah, yes. The values needing 5 bits can be used by SBAS L5 messages only. I have now removed them from the mapping.

Also:

Warning: epan/dissectors/packet-sbas_l1.c : value_string URA - value 13 missing? ( 15 entries)

It looks to me (from https://ffac.ch/wp-content/uploads/2020/09/ICAO-Annex-10-Aeronautical-Telecommunications-Vol-I-Radio-Navigation-Aids.pdf) as though this should be "2048 m" ?
Indeed, thanks! Value added now (after confirming "2048 m" in the Annex 10, Vol I, 8th edition).

commits_data.message:
GNSS: reference current edition of ICAO Annex 10 for SBAS L1 definition

Reference current edition of ICAO Annex 10, Vol I (8th edition) for the
definition of SBAS L1 messages. Add SBAS service provider identifiers
as defined by this edition and as relevant for L1. Add missing URA
mapping.
